name: ftp-hardening-off-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): flips the Saltmarsh VendorDrop FTP site into the planted insecure state -- anonymous authentication on, a server-level Allow '*' Read/Write authorization rule, SslAllow with no certificate bound, user isolation None, Everyone:(OI)(CI)F on C:\inetpub\saltmarsh\ftproot, and the SaltmarshFtpIn firewall rule widened to RemoteAddress Any. Vars: none. Pairs with ftp_anonymous_off, ftp_anonymous_write_off, ftp_control_ssl_required, ftp_data_ssl_required, ftp_user_isolation_on, ftp_root_acl_restricted, ftp_firewall_scoped. Depends on iis-ftp-base-win. Idempotent.
script:
Import-Module WebAdministration -ErrorAction Ignore
$ftpBase = "system.applicationHost/sites/site[@name='VendorDrop']/ftpServer"
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter "$ftpBase/security/authentication/anonymousAuthentication" -Name enabled -Value $true
Clear-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter 'system.ftpServer/security/authorization' -ErrorAction Ignore
Add-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter 'system.ftpServer/security/authorization' `
    -Value @{accessType = 'Allow'; users = '*'; permissions = 'Read, Write'}
Add-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter 'system.ftpServer/security/authorization' `
    -Value @{accessType = 'Allow'; roles = 'SaltmarshVendors'; permissions = 'Read'}
Add-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter 'system.ftpServer/security/authorization' `
    -Value @{accessType = 'Allow'; users = 'ftp_vendor'; permissions = 'Read, Write'}

Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter "$ftpBase/security/ssl" -Name controlChannelPolicy -Value 'SslAllow'
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter "$ftpBase/security/ssl" -Name dataChannelPolicy -Value 'SslAllow'
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter "$ftpBase/security/ssl" -Name serverCertHash -Value '' -ErrorAction Ignore
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' `
    -Filter "$ftpBase/userIsolation" -Name mode -Value 'None'

icacls 'C:\inetpub\saltmarsh\ftproot' /grant 'Everyone:(OI)(CI)(F)' | Out-Null

if (Get-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshFtpIn' -ErrorAction Ignore) {
    Set-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshFtpIn' -RemoteAddress 'Any' -ErrorAction Ignore
} else {
    New-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshFtpIn' -DisplayName 'SaltmarshFtpIn' `
        -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 21 -Action Allow -Profile Any | Out-Null
}
Write-Output 'FTP hardening off'
